lines.lyric_translation: Will you hug me tight until I fall asleep?
Even on mornings we spend together,
Even on days when I’ve had a hard time,
Will you hug me even tighter?
Will you hug me while we’re together?

lines.lyric: Eodi gaji malgo nawa pyeongsaeng isseojuseyo
lines.lyric_hangul: 어디 가지 말고 나와 평생 있어주세요
lines.lyric_translation: Don’t go anywhere, please just stay with me forever
Every day, I just want to make you happy
I’ll hug you warmly
Don’t leave me

lines.lyric: Neoye yeppeun useum ilchi anke haejulgeyo
lines.lyric_hangul: 너의 예쁜 웃음 잃지 않게 해줄게요
lines.lyric_translation: I’ll make sure I don’t lose your pretty smile
Please hug me too
Be with me
I’ll make every day sweet for you

lines.lyric: I’ll give you a hug oh baby
lines.lyric_hangul: I'll give you a hug oh baby
lines.lyric_translation: I’ll give you a hug oh baby

lines.lyric: Please give me a hug oh baby
lines.lyric_hangul: Please give me a hug oh baby
lines.lyric_translation: Please give me a hug oh baby

lines.lyric: Unneun eolgul uneun eolgul modu joaseo
lines.lyric_hangul: 웃는 얼굴 우는 얼굴 모두 좋아서
lines.lyric_translation: Your laughing face, your crying face, I like it all
I want to hug you today as well
My head is full of only you,
So I think of you all day long
Will you hug me tight while we’re together now too?

lines.lyric: Himdeulgo jichin sungando yeope naega isseojulgeyo
lines.lyric_hangul: 힘들고 지친 순간도 옆에 내가 있어줄게요
lines.lyric_translation: Even when you’re tired or worn out, I’ll stay by your side

lines.lyric_hangul: 슬픈 날들은 내 곁으로 와 기대요 내 품에
lines.lyric_translation: On days when you’re sad, / Come to my side and lean into my embrace
